description: Get written answers, analysis and recommendations for SME owners and managers. All without expensive licenses, specialized consultants or complex BI tools.
how-subtitle: From raw data to a defensible decision in three steps.
how-step1-desc: Start with what you already have — Excel — or connect MySQL, PostgreSQL or MongoDB. Give it a name, fill in the connection details, and you're done. No migration needed.
how-step2-desc: Ask questions about your business in plain language, the same way you would ask a senior consultant. Or get started with one of the recommended queries based on your data.
how-step3-desc: Get verifiable answers, executive summaries and charts ready to share — and the confidence to defend them.
modes-section-subtitle: A complete workflow from question to decision, not just another dashboard.
f1-desc: Ask any business question in plain language — just as you would ask a consultant — whether your data is in Excel spreadsheets or MySQL, PostgreSQL or MongoDB databases. Speak2DB queries the AI to retrieve the information, then save what worked and re-run it anytime without querying the AI — with near-instant results. Organize your saved questions into the categories that fit your business and explore results with business insights and data consistency analysis.
f3-desc: Define the rules that matter to your business. Speak2DB watches your data and emails you when stock runs low, sales drop unexpectedly, or anomalies appear.
f4-desc: Create AI-assisted dashboards in minutes. Speak2DB recommends the most relevant KPIs and charts for your data, analyzes every visualization, explains what it means and generates executive summaries ready to share.
f6-desc: Store the executive summaries generated from your dashboards and compare them side by side to understand how your business evolves over time.
f7-desc: Speak2DB never modifies your original data. Your spreadsheets and databases stay exactly as they are.
f8-desc: Start from your existing Excel file and export results with one click, including charts your team can open and share immediately. No migration needed — scale to databases when you're ready.

faq-a1: Yes. Speak2DB works with read-only access, so your spreadsheets and databases are never modified — not a single value changes. On top of that, you only share with the platform certain schema data from your data source and some statistical samples. Speak2DB never stores your queries or answers, and signs a Zero Data Retention contract with its providers: your data is never stored or used for any additional purpose. In practice, the data you send us is anonymous and disappears after the response.
faq-q2: Do I need technical help to connect my data?
faq-a2: No prior technical experience is needed. The guided assistant walks you step by step through connecting your Excel files or your MySQL, PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases. For databases, you only need your connection string and read permissions on hand.
faq-q3: Do I need to install anything?
faq-a3: Speak2DB is a desktop app for Windows. Your data stays where it is — it is not uploaded to the cloud.
faq-q4: Can my technical team validate the queries?
faq-a4: Absolutely. You can view and share the technical query Speak2DB generates, so your IT team can verify every result.
faq-a5: Your feedback shapes the product. As an early user you keep an advantage: the insights you build now stay with you, and you help decide what we build next.
faq-q6: Do I need to pay for any additional AI plan or API keys?
faq-a6: No. The app connects to the Speak2DB platform, which already includes the most efficient models for the tasks it performs.
faq-q7: Why do I see SQL code instead of traditional Excel formulas?
faq-a7: Instead of repeating thousands of formulas cell by cell (which slow down your file), our app concentrates all the logic of your report into a single 'Super-Formula' written in SQL. It is the modern, safe, and ultra-fast way to process data without overloading your spreadsheet.
